plates.title: RNA-accessibility agreement: representation sensitivity
plates.subtitle: Frozen external WT IL4-versus-control contrasts | F1 presentation replacement | offset 1
caption: Equal-gene weighting changes agreement only slightly; mixed ATAC directions remain common in the broad mapped universe.
Rows and genes share source libraries. No independent-trial inference; similar mappings are not independent validation.
All mapped rows remain in denominators. Distance is to the source nearest TSS, not necessarily the Ensembl-assigned gene.

plates.title: Human macrophage panels: IPF-Control contrasts
plates.subtitle: Six fixed cohort / annotation / source scopes | original donor estimates and pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals
caption: Compare the same two RNA summaries across source definitions: matrix-associated estimates are positive; FABP4-panel direction varies.
Points, intervals and donor counts are copied from frozen results. Annotations, cell floors and source-site composition differ.
The primary FABP4 interval spans zero. RNA panels do not measure matrix production, secretion or repair.

plates.title: Within-IPF coupling of the two macrophage RNA panels
plates.subtitle: Primary Macrophage20 and external union50, all sources | no bootstrap recomputation
caption: Compare original uncertainty with observed sensitivity: single-component and single-donor omission ranges remain negative.
Only panel A shows a 95% bootstrap interval; panels B/C show influence ranges, not confidence intervals.
The external original interval spans zero. Omission stability does not establish significance, causality or independent replication.

plates.title: GRIP1/NCOA2 reference: RNA-accessibility correlation
plates.subtitle: Separate within-condition cKO-minus-WT transformed-mean effects | all four frozen mapping/subset summaries
caption: Compare mapped-row associations on the full Spearman scale: the saved global RNA-accessibility correlations are weak.
Mapped rows share genes and source libraries; no confidence interval or p-value is inferred from their count.
Separate source-labelled IL4/CTRL comparisons are not an interaction, causal mechanism or evidence of true absence.
